claims.statement: For the uniform T_m family, the complete selected lower-region sum is strictly negative for every eligible rank through m=999, as independently reproduced by exact integer replay. The proposed extension to all m is retained only conditionally on the stated m>=1000 perturbation bounds and the registered n<=4x forest descent estimate; this review does not independently certify those steps.
claims.scope: T_m is the path a-b-r with m three-leaf arms attached at r, for integer m>=1. The independently verified bounded statement covers every eligible p with x(T_m)+2<=p and 3p<2alpha(T_m)+1 for 1<=m<=999. Any all-m consequence remains conditional on the large-m inequalities and forest descent bound. No assertion for arbitrary ordinary trees.
claims.reason: retained_narrowed: copied exact replay reproduces both finite central-check digests and all 276,938 selector/full-sum rows with no failures; the ULC hypotheses, theorem bridge, mixed-minor orientation, polynomial decomposition, rank transfer conditional on n<=4x, and total-sum coefficient shift check out. The allowed route files do not provide a reconstructible index-by-index derivation of the m>=1000 cutoff/error constants, and the cited forest descent proof is outside the case pins, so the all-m result is not independently verified here.

limitations: The exact replay is bounded to 1<=m<=999 and is not kernel checked.
The m>=1000 perturbation inequalities and their 27 index bounds are not fully expanded in the permitted case files.
The graph-to-selector transfer depends on the registered n<=4x forest descent bound, whose proof was not in this case packet.
No conclusion is given for arbitrary ordinary trees or the complete primary assertion.
